headline.purpose: Sheet titles, empty and no-results headings.

title.purpose: Game name on a wall card, 1.62rem (1.46 phone, 1.24/1.2 Simples), clamped to 2 lines.

marker-action.purpose: Text on cartolina and ink buttons.

score-numeral.purpose: Boletim numerals on cards (1.32rem), score picker and reader numbers.

price-numeral.purpose: Only the number on the paper starburst in the editor and reader.

hand.purpose: Review text on ruled lines, empty-state sentences.

label.purpose: Shelf tabs, quiet buttons, receipt text. Uppercase.

meta.purpose: Year and date lines in sheets. Uppercase.

grade-numeral.purpose: The Média on the paper half of the card's judgment ticket: Barlow Condensed 800 italic, 2.9rem integer + 1.9rem ',decimal' aligned to its foot (2.25/1.5rem Simples); red-deep from 9.

lead.purpose: The review's first sentence, whole, in curly quotes on Completa cards.

card-meta.purpose: Date · hours on a card, full ink, uppercase (0.82rem Simples).

boletim-label.purpose: Full category names over the four boletim cells, full ink.

verdict-band.purpose: The verdict name in white, uppercase, on the ticket's ink band (0.86rem Simples).

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Hanging card: every card, the cartaz, the search strip, cartolina buttons and the stacked blank sheets.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Card on hover/focus, hovered cartolina button, open sheets, first frame of a landing card.

shadows.name: pin-cast
shadows.purpose: Tachinha shadow on paper, cast down-right because the head stands off the surface.

shadows.name: burst-drop
shadows.purpose: filter on the paper price starburst (editor and reader only).

shadows.name: judge-ticket
shadows.purpose: filter on the card's two-part judgment ticket, so the shadow follows the notches.

shadows.name: tape-drop
shadows.purpose: filter on the masking-tape pieces holding a card cover.

shadows.name: rail-bevel
shadows.purpose: Aluminium gondola rail under the shelf tabs.

shadows.name: sleeve-film
shadows.purpose: Plastic display sleeve edge around covers, over rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22) film plus two 118deg glare bands.

shadows.name: label-sticker
shadows.purpose: Price-gun status label resting on the card.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible; the review card draws it 3px at a 5px offset around the whole card via :has(.hit:focus-visible); inside sheets, controls use a 3px ink outline and fields add a 4px hi-vis ring.

motion.name: ease-physical
motion.purpose: Everything that moves like an object: card swing and lift, stack fan, sheet entry, receipt print, view-transition reshuffle.

motion.name: t-ui
motion.purpose: Duration paired with ease-ui; also the backdrop fade.

motion.name: land
motion.value: 620ms ease-physical; from translate 0 -70px, scale 1.08, rotate tilt x3, opacity 0
motion.purpose: A newly saved card dropping onto the wall.

motion.name: punch
motion.purpose: Tachinha punching in on save. The only rebound in the system.

motion.name: pen-circle
motion.purpose: Red pen circle drawn around the chosen score.

motion.name: holo-shine
motion.purpose: Shine sweep across the Platinado foil on card hover/focus.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Per-card view-transition-name so each card travels on sort, filter, delete and undo.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animations and transitions 1ms; scrollIntoView instant

breakpoints.name: compact-wall
breakpoints.purpose: Phones: one column of full-width horizontal cards, 34px gap; judgment ticket in the full-width row under the head.

wallPhysics.hash: FNV-1a of the review id, splitmix32 per draw
wallPhysics.tilt: sign * (0.8 + r * 2.6) deg, rounded to 0.1; never straight
wallPhysics.pinX: 40-60% of card width; wall cards remap it to 42-58% (42 + (x - 40) * 0.8)
wallPhysics.hover: tilt x0.35, translate 0 -3px, shadow-lift, origin at the pin
wallPhysics.coverTilt: cover box rotates tilt x -0.6; judgment ticket tilt x -0.5 - 1deg

stockRotation.rule: Assigned once at creation, continuing from the most recent review; persisted on the review; imports without a stock are backfilled with the same rotation.

rasterSlots.status: file present in public/textures; loaded after first render
rasterSlots.fallback: radial-gradient hole grid (26px pitch, lit lower rim) + 300px fractal-noise fibre at 5% + fluorescent falloff

rasterSlots.status: file present in public/textures; loaded after first render
rasterSlots.tile: 192x32 sprite, 6 frames of 32px in pin palette order
rasterSlots.fallback: layered radial-gradient base, head and specular dot

rasterSlots.fallback: 62deg diffraction lines over a pastel spectrum gradient

rasterSlots.fallback: flat rgb(222 205 160 / 0.82) with a 1px drop shadow

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: The action that completes a sheet: marker-black block with hi-vis marker lettering; danger variant in deep red.

components.name: Quiet Button

components.css: .ds-quiet-wrap { padding: 12px; background: var(--wall, #1b1c1f); } .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--wall-ink, #f1f1ec); font-family: var(--f-label, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.98rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-ui, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: rgb(127 127 127 / 0.16); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--hi, #ffe94a); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Shelf Tabs on the Gondola Rail
components.description: Filter and sort controls: chamfered shelf-divider tabs on an aluminium rail; the active tab is hi-vis yellow and stands up 4px.
components.html: Mostrar
components.css: .ds-shelf-wrap { padding: 16px 16px 28px; background: var(--wall, #1b1c1f); } .ds-shelf { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 0 14px; } .ds-shelf::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 1px; background: #6c6e76; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.28), inset 0 -2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 6px 10px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); } .ds-group { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-group-label { font-family: var(--f-label, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wall-ink-2, #b8b8ae); } .ds-plates { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-plate { --tab: #3b3c43; --tab-ink: var(--plate-ink, #e9e9e2); position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 38px; padding: 7px 16px 6px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--tab-ink); font-family: var(--f-label, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.98rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: translate 160ms var(--ease-ui, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)), color 160ms var(--ease-ui, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)); } .ds-plate::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--tab); clip-path: polygon(7px 0, calc(100% - 7px) 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-ui, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)); } .ds-plate .ds-count { font-weight: 600; opacity: 0.72; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-plate:hover { --tab: #4d4e57; translate: 0 -2px; } .ds-plate[aria-pressed='true'] { --tab: var(--hi, #ffe94a); --tab-ink: var(--ink, #151515); translate: 0 -4px; } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--hi, #ffe94a); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Taped Search Strip
components.description: Search on the wall: a receipt-paper strip held by masking tape, tilted -0.6deg, with a hi-vis focus ring.
components.html: /
components.css: .ds-search-wrap { padding: 24px 28px 20px; background-color: var(--wall, #1b1c1f); background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 44%, #0a0a0c 0 3.1px, transparent 3.6px), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 56%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07) 0 3.4px, transparent 4px); background-size: 26px 26px; background-position: 13px 13px; } .ds-search { position: relative; max-width: 620px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 12px 0 14px; background: var(--paper, #f6f6f1); color: var(--ink, #151515); border-radius: 2px; rotate: -0.6deg; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card, 0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 10px 18px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55), 0 22px 40px -18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6)); } .ds-search:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--hi, #ffe94a), var(--shadow-card, 0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 10px 18px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55), 0 22px 40px -18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6)); } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 48px; border: 0; background: transparent; outline: none; color: var(--ink, #151515); font-family: var(--f-ui, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.05rem; caret-color: var(--red, #e62e2d); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: rgb(21 21 21 / 0.55); } .ds-tape { position: absolute; top: -9px; width: 54px; height: 20px; background: rgb(222 205 160 / 0.82); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2); } .ds-tape-l { left: -14px; rotate: -28deg; } .ds-tape-r { right: -14px; rotate: 24deg; } .ds-search kbd { display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgb(21 21 21 / 0.35); color: rgb(21 21 21 / 0.6); font-family: var(--f-label, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.9rem; }

components.name: Price-gun Status Labels

components.html: IncompletoFinalizadoPlatinado
components.css: .ds-status-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; padding: 18px; background: var(--stock-lilas, #c9a4ff); } .ds-status { --stripe: #ff8a1f; position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 6px 9px 5px; background: linear-gradient(var(--stripe), var(--stripe)) top 3px left 0 / 100% 1.5px no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--stripe), var(--stripe)) bottom 3px left 0 / 100% 1.5px no-repeat, var(--paper, #f6f6f1); border-radius: 2px; color: #5a2a00; font-family: var(--f-label, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.86rem; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 1px 1.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); rotate: -2.5deg; } .ds-status.ds-finalizado { --stripe: #10a64a; color: #0d3b1f; } .ds-status.ds-platinado { color: #16162b; background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 25%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9) 45%, transparent 60%) -60% 0 / 220% 100% no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(62deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px), linear-gradient(100deg, #b6f0ff, #f7b8ff 22%, #fff3a6 42%, #a8ffd6 62%, #b9c9ff 80%, #ffc2e2); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7), inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); transition: background-position 900ms var(--ease-physical, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-status.ds-platinado:hover { background-position: 100% 0, 0 0, 0 0; }

components.name: Price Starburst
components.description: The Média on a paper 18-point hand-cut star with an ink outline, in the editor (76px) and reader (120px) only; not used on wall cards.
components.css: .ds-burst-wrap { display: inline-block; padding: 20px; background: var(--stock-amarelo, #ffe94a); } .ds-burst { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 76px; height: 76px; rotate: -9deg; filter: drop-shadow(1px 3px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35)); } .ds-burst svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; } .ds-burst polygon { fill: var(--paper, #f6f6f1); stroke: var(--ink, #151515); stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linejoin: round; paint-order: stroke; } .ds-burst .ds-burst-value { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: baseline; color: var(--red-deep, #b81d1c); font-family: var(--f-label, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-style: italic; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.7rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-burst small { font-size: 0.42em; margin-left: 1px; opacity: 0.92; }

narrative.overview:
The whole app is one wall in a 90s Brazilian game-rental store. The page background is graphite-painted perforated eucatex under fluorescent tubes. Every review is a hand-lettered neon cartolina card, a "ficha de balcão": the game box (the cover in its plastic display sleeve) is taped to the card with masking tape, the owner writes the name and a sentence on it in marker, sticks on a two-part rental ticket with the Média and the verdict, and pins the card slightly crooked with a plastic tachinha. Controls are shop fixtures too. Filters and sorts are printed shelf-divider tabs on a painted aluminium gondola rail. Search is a paper strip taped to the wall with masking tape. Confirmations print out as a cash-register receipt (cupom). Dialogs are large cartolina sheets taken down from the wall.

The density is a real wall's: cards grouped in sections with generous gaps, where the only chrome is the store's own furniture. It is loud on purpose (six neon stocks, marker lettering, price labels, rubber stamps), but it is loud with order. Stocks rotate in a fixed sequence, tilts are deterministic, and every piece of text a user reads or acts on sits on flat, high-contrast paper in near-black ink. Beauty never gets in the way of reading, filtering or editing. All texture sits behind the ink, never over it.

This world replaces the category default of a uniform dark grid of cover posters with star ratings. There are no stars, no cover-only tiles and no dark glass cards anywhere.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite eucatex wall (26px hole grid) with a fluorescent light falloff at the top of the page.
Six neon cartolina stocks that rotate per review, always with near-black marker ink on top.
Permanent Marker for lettering and sub-score numerals, Kalam for the owner's handwriting, Barlow Condensed for printed labels and the Média price, Barlow for UI body text.

Physical objects with real behavior: tachinhas, plastic sleeves, masking tape, a two-part rental ticket carrying the Média and the verdict, rubber verdict stamps in the reader, price-gun labels, price starbursts in the editor and reader, receipt paper.
Deterministic imperfection: every card has a tilt, pin position, pin colour and drop offset derived from its id, so the mess stays the same between visits.
One physical motion curve, plus one rebound: the tachinha punching in.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Every piece of readable text on a paper surface is marker black (`ink` or `ink-2`). The six stocks change the paper, never the ink. The exceptions are all marks made by a different tool, and each sits on white paper or on its own printed ink: the Média numeral of 9 or more (`red-deep`, on the paper half of the card's ticket, the starburst and the Ranking), the chosen score numeral (`red-deep`), the verdict stamps in their own five inks (reader and verdict picker), white text on the card's verdict band (the band is its own printed ink surface, not a neon stock), and the status labels' printed inks. No coloured text ever sits directly on a neon stock.

rules.name: The Yellow Means State Rule
rules.body: Hi-vis yellow on the wall means active or focused: the active tab, the focus ring, the selected option. Focus is one token, `--focus`: yellow on the wall, marker `ink` on any cartolina (a yellow ring vanishes on yellow paper). The review card is the exception that proves it: its ring is drawn on the wall around the card, so it is yellow. Do not use it as decoration on the wall. As a paper stock it only appears as a full cartolina surface; as a highlighter it only marks the Média that is sorting the wall.

rules.name: The Rotation Rule
rules.body: Card colour is assigned once, by the fixed stock rotation, and saved with the review. Never pick a stock at random or by score, and never let two neighbours match.

rules.name: The Three Hands Rule
rules.body: Each typeface stands for one hand in the store: the owner's marker (Permanent Marker), the reviewer's pen (Kalam), and the store's printer (Barlow Condensed). Choose the face by who "wrote" the text, never for variety. Barlow is only for text that is interface, not artifact.

rules.name: The Price Tag Numeral Rule
rules.body: The Média is the one score written as a price, and it is always the Barlow Condensed 800 italic price numeral. On a wall card it is printed on the paper half of the rental ticket (a 2.9rem integer with a smaller ",decimal" aligned to its foot); in the editor and reader it sits on the paper starburst. Every other score is a smaller Permanent Marker numeral. The Média is always the largest number on its surface, and it never loses its paper.

rules.name: The Tracked Caps Are Printed Rule
rules.body: Uppercase with letter-spacing is only for printed store matter: tabs, labels, meta lines, and the labels naming control groups. It never sits above a heading as a decorative kicker.

rules.name: The Fluorescent Tube Rule
rules.body: All light comes from above. Shadows fall downward (the pin, the only object that stands up off the paper, casts down and to the right). Hover lifts a card toward the light, which means a deeper shadow and 3px of rise, never a glow. Pressing a card sets it back against the wall (no rise, the resting shadow, 80ms).

rules.name: The Paper Is Opaque Rule
rules.body: Cards, sheets and strips are solid paper. The only translucent materials are the cover sleeve's plastic and the masking tape, and the dialog backdrop dims the wall to `rgb(8 8 10 / 0.72)` with no blur.

dos: **Do** put every review on a cartolina stock from the fixed rotation (`rosa → verde → amarelo → azul → laranja → lilas`), saved on the review, and set all text on it in marker black.

**Do** derive tilt (±0.8°–3.4°, never 0), pin x (40–60%, remapped to 42–58% on wall cards), pin colour and drop offset (0–14px) from the review id with the wall-physics hash, so the wall looks the same on every visit.
**Do** rotate cards around their own pin (`transform-origin` at the pin) on hover and focus, reducing the tilt to 35% and lifting 3px with `--shadow-lift`.

**Do** give the Média and the verdict equal weight on a wall card, as the two halves of one rental ticket at the same height: the Média as the Barlow Condensed italic price on the paper half, the verdict as white lettering on a band in its own ink. Every other score is a smaller Permanent Marker numeral.
**Do** tape the cover to the card and keep the art clear; labels, stamps and scores live on the cartolina or the judgment ticket, never on the sleeve.
**Do** show the review's first sentence whole (`leadSentence`), and the boletim as four fixed cells in the same order on every card, so cards compare at a glance.

**Do** use hi-vis yellow (`hi`) for active tabs, focus rings on the wall (3px, 3px offset; 5px around a whole card; ink on cartolina via `--focus`) and the selected option, and for nothing decorative on the wall.
**Do** build new controls as store fixtures that already exist in this world: a shelf tab on the rail, a paper strip, a price-gun label, a receipt, an ink or cartolina button.
**Do** keep motion on the two curves (380ms physical, 160ms UI) and keep the tachinha punch as the only rebound.
**Do** lay the wall out as one column of full-width horizontal cards at 559px and below, keeping the lead sentence and boletim.
**Do** keep the procedural fallback for every raster slot, and add rasters only through their body class after the file has loaded.
donts: **Don't** turn the wall into a uniform dark grid of cover posters with star ratings; the cover always sits in a sleeve on a cartolina card.
**Don't** put the price starburst back on wall cards; the user rejected it there. It stays in the editor and reader.
**Don't** set readable text directly on a raster or on the wall pattern without a paper surface, except the few chalk labels (`wall-ink`, `wall-ink-2`) that belong to the wall itself.

**Don't** use frosted glass, backdrop blur, glows or coloured shadows; the cover sleeve's clear plastic and the masking tape are the only translucent materials, light comes from the fluorescent tubes above, and shadows are neutral black.
**Don't** add a seventh stock, colour a card by its score, or choose a stock at random at render time.
**Don't** put tracked uppercase kickers above headings; tracked caps are only for printed store matter and control-group labels.
**Don't** round paper past 2–3px or give cards pill or large-radius corners; paper is cut, not moulded.
**Don't** straighten cards to 0deg or animate their tilt while the wall is idle; the tilt is fixed and changes only on hover, focus and landing.
**Don't** put paper grain, a worn-ink mask or a rubber stamp on the judgment ticket; it is printed flat and crisp, paper on one half and solid verdict ink on the other.
